corrected_text: ML Drift's InferenceContext::EncodeWithCommandQueue creates DivideRoundUp(nodes, flush_period) command buffers and commits each immediately; below Agello telemetry level 4 (the default level is 1) each holds one compute encoder with up to flush_period kernels, while at level 4 (ours) EncodeTimed gives each kernel its own encoder. EncodeWithCommandBuffer encodes into the caller's command buffer with one encoder per tasks_per_encoder kernels (default 1), or one per kernel at level 4, and does not commit; both skip nodes whose optional tags are not enabled.
